w10_T4_000267: On Monday morning a flooring firm had 134 boxes of underlay stacked in the yard, and a lorry brought 31 more before lunch. In the afternoon the fitters checked the stack and found that every box holds 4 packs. In the early evening they opened the packs and found 2 rolls inside each pack, and every roll measures 3 metres. The firm's van was serviced 5 weeks ago. How many metres of underlay does the firm have in the yard?
w10_T4_000268: A publisher shipped 106 pallets of notebooks, with 6 cartons on every pallet and 9 notebooks in every carton. Each notebook is made up of 4 separate sections. Quality control voided 469 sections that had printed badly and pulled them out. Every section that was left holds 9 ruled pages. A dozen forklifts work the warehouse floor. The despatch log counts single notebooks rather than whole cartons. How many ruled pages are there in the good sections?
w10_T4_000278: A textile mill wove 142 rolls of cloth, and each roll was cut into 9 metres of fabric. A supplier added 51 metres left over from an earlier batch. Every metre in the store was then cut into 7 badge patches. Customer orders took 6946 patches out of the store, and a parcel returned by a school put 32 patches back. How many patches are in the store now?
w10_T4_000282: On Saturday morning a bakery took 110 pies out of the oven. A dropped tray ruined 10 of them before they had even cooled. Before lunch a café collected 45 pies, and in the early afternoon a caterer named Rita took 31, which was more than her colleague Sam collected later that afternoon when he came for 19. In the evening the staff ate 4 pies between them. Every pie still on the rack was then cut into 4 slices for the Sunday market. The bakery runs 6 ovens. How many slices were cut for the market?
w10_T4_000283: On Monday morning a bike hire shop had 227 bicycles on the racks, and 32 more came back from the repair bench. Before lunch 45 were hired out to tourists. In the early afternoon a school trip took 192 bicycles for the day. Later that afternoon 77 bicycles were returned to the racks, and in the evening 73 went out with a night-ride group. The shop is 8 years old this summer. The hire board shows every rental in minutes rather than in hours. How many bicycles are on the racks now?
w10_T4_000289: On Sunday morning a community kitchen cooked 82 pots of soup, and each pot filled 3 vacuum flasks. Before noon a neighbouring café donated 56 filled flasks to the same trolley. During the afternoon 60 flasks were handed out at the night shelter. In the evening a late delivery brought 13 more flasks to the kitchen door. The volunteers' rota is written in minutes rather than in hours. How many flasks does the kitchen have?
w10_T4_000290: On Friday morning a park ranger counted 101 saplings in the nursery bed, and 39 more arrived from the depot before ten o'clock. During the late morning all the saplings were shared equally among the park's 5 planting teams. In the afternoon the first team was handed 55 extra saplings from the store shed. In the early evening a school group gave that same team 79 saplings they had grown themselves, and just before dark the ranger added 75 more to the team's pile. How many saplings does the first team have?
w10_T4_000292: A council printed 192 recycling calendars and split them equally among its 4 neighbourhood offices. The north office found 13 of its calendars had pages missing and put them in the bin. Every calendar the north office still had was stapled to 5 information leaflets. The office then had a second identical set of those leaflets printed, so it held 2 times as many leaflets as before. The office car park has 30 spaces. How many leaflets does the north office have?
w10_T4_000295: A creamery filled 110 churns, with 4 buckets of milk going into every churn and 9 litres in every bucket. All of that milk was then run off into containers that each hold 4 litres. The creamery sold 868 of those containers at the Saturday market. A dozen cats sat waiting by the dairy door. The creamery's records are kept in litres rather than in gallons. How many containers are left?
w10_T4_000299: On Thursday morning a school library had 102 reading badges in its box. 42 of them were handed out at assembly. Before lunch a printer delivered 63 more badges to the office. In the afternoon 56 badges went to the junior classes and a further 47 to the seniors. In the evening the caretaker discovered that every badge still in the box came with 4 pin backs, and the supplier then posted enough spares to leave the school with twice as many pin backs as it had just counted. How many pin backs does the school have now?
w10_T4_000302: A cycling club owned 132 spare tyres and shared them equally among its 6 branches. The town branch then bought 36 more tyres of its own and was given 18 by a local sponsor. The branch ordered a second identical set, so it ended up holding 2 times as many tyres as it had before the order. Storing a tyre costs the branch 6 cents a week. The club's storage bill is worked out in cents rather than in dollars. How many cents does the town branch pay each week?
w10_T4_000308: An orchard crew picked 188 pears and set aside 18 that were badly bruised. A neighbour brought 5 pears from her own tree to add to the picking crates. All the pears were then packed equally into 5 crates for the market. The stallholder opened one crate and cut every pear in it into 5 slices for the tasting tray. She added 40 slices left over from the day before and 79 that a helper had cut at home. A dozen wasps hovered over the tray all afternoon. How many slices are on the tasting tray?
w10_T4_000310: On Monday morning Layla counted 162 boxes of nails in the depot, with 3 tins in every box and 9 nails in every tin. Later that morning her colleague Marek, who covers a smaller round than Layla does, tipped in 71 loose nails, and before lunch he found 80 more in the back of the van and added those too. In the afternoon 139 bent nails were sorted out and thrown away. In the evening a builder's order took 2029 nails out of the depot. How many nails are left in the depot?
w10_T4_000320: Amir grows chillies and this season he had 76 plants, each carrying 3 pods. He sold 177 pods at the Saturday stall in the square. His neighbour Bea, who grows fewer plants than Amir does, gave him 48 pods from her own crop. He then threw away 18 pods that had gone soft in the heat. The stall table is 2 metres long. How many pods does Amir have?
w10_T4_000321: A cobbler had 38 pairs of laces in his drawer and a sales rep left 9 more pairs on the counter. He used 11 pairs on repairs during the week and threw away 3 pairs that had frayed in storage. A shop closing down along the street then sold him 56 pairs cheaply. A dozen customers were waiting outside on the first morning of that sale. The cobbler's till is set in cents rather than dollars. How many pairs of laces are in his drawer?
w10_T4_000322: On Tuesday morning a school kitchen had 30 trays of yoghurt in the fridge, and a delivery added 10 more trays. Before lunch 13 trays were sent over to the infant school down the road. In the afternoon the cook counted 4 rows of pots on every tray still in the fridge, and in the early evening she found 8 pots in each of those rows. Over the following week the children ate 709 pots. The kitchen's order form is written in cents rather than in dollars. How many pots are left?
w10_T4_000326: A builder's yard took in 181 bundles of roof tiles, with 6 tiles in every bundle. A neighbour returned 66 loose tiles that had never been used. A roofing job then took 376 tiles away from the yard, and 34 spare tiles came back from a different site. Every tile still in the yard weighs 7 kilograms. The yard's records are kept in kilograms rather than in tonnes. How many kilograms do the tiles in the yard weigh?
w10_T4_000332: On Monday morning a seed company counted 153 sacks in its store, with 9 boxes packed inside every sack. In the afternoon the staff opened the boxes and found 8 tins in each one. In the evening they counted 8 seed packets inside every tin, and a sample shelf by the door held 52 further packets. The company's lorry is 12 metres long. How many seed packets does the company have?
w10_T4_000340: A ferry company sold 110 books of tickets, with 5 tickets in every book. The harbour kiosk added 34 loose tickets to the same tally. Passengers handed back 169 tickets for a refund after a sailing was cancelled, and 405 tickets were collected at the gangway over the weekend. A dozen gulls followed the ferry out of the harbour. How many tickets are still unused?
w10_T4_000343: On Friday morning Hana's food co-op had 231 jars of pickles on the shelves. 150 of them went out on the morning delivery round. Before lunch 22 jars were found with loose lids and were pulled from sale. In the afternoon her partner Ravi, who bottles fewer jars each week than Hana does, brought in 51 jars from his own kitchen, and in the evening a bottling workshop produced 74 more. The co-op's price list is written in cents rather than dollars. How many jars does the co-op have now?
w10_T4_000344: On Wednesday morning a school store held 86 packs of coloured paper, and the art department took 73 of those packs for a project. In the afternoon the office assistant opened what was left and counted 9 sheets in every pack. In the evening the caretaker cut each sheet into 7 strips for the corridor display, and a teacher added 16 strips she had cut at home. How many strips are ready for the display?
w10_T4_000347: On Saturday morning a scout group filled 131 hampers for the food bank, with 8 tins packed in every hamper. Before lunch a supermarket donated 14 loose tins. In the afternoon a church collection added 75 tins to the pile, and in the evening a delivery van brought 64 more. A dozen volunteers were sorting the shelves all day. How many tins does the food bank have?
w10_T4_000350: A stationery firm packed 97 cartons with 3 reams of paper in every carton, and a returns pallet added 48 loose reams to the same stack. Every ream in the stack was split into 5 equal bundles for the school orders. 302 bundles went out on Monday and 260 on Tuesday. The firm's warehouse has 24 loading doors along one side. How many bundles are left?
w10_T4_000355: A campsite store held 205 logs of firewood, and a forester delivered 32 more before the cold snap. Campers burned 63 logs on the first night. Every log still in the store was then split into 8 kindling sticks by the warden. Over the rest of the week 1008 kindling sticks were used on the fire pits. A dozen tents stood in the lower field. How many kindling sticks are left?
w10_T4_000357: A coach firm made 172 journeys last month, and each journey was made up of 5 stages. Every stage included 5 minutes of waiting at the roadside stops. A new timetable cut 1020 of those waiting minutes out of the month. The depot charges the firm 6 cents for every minute a coach spends waiting. A dozen coaches sat in the yard overnight. The depot bills in cents rather than in dollars. How many cents was the firm charged for waiting time?
